model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC percentage for six different methods. The x-axis represents Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis represents ACC percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features six lines, each representing a method: Base (black, solid, circles), FT (blue, solid, triangles), IKE (red, solid, triangles), MEND (brown, solid), MEMIT (purple, solid), and ROME (green, solid). The Base line starts at approximately 39 and ends at 44, showing a slight increase. The FT line starts at approximately 40 and ends at 48, showing a steady increase. The IKE line starts at approximately 43 and ends at 49, showing a steady increase. The MEND line starts at approximately 43 and ends at 56, showing a steady increase. The MEMIT line starts at approximately 44 and ends at 54, showing a steady increase. The ROME line starts at approximately 52 and ends at 65, showing a steady increase.
